units.source_text: 源氏回到六条院，偷偷地钻进房间里。

en.t: Genji returned to the Rokujo estate and slipped quietly into the room.

units.source_text: 紫姬起来迎接，看到他那睡眼蒙眬的模样，已经猜测到他的去处，然而不动声色。

en.t: Lady Murasaki rose to greet him, and from his sleepy, bleary look she had already guessed where he had been, though she showed nothing.

units.source_text: 源氏觉得她这态度比妒恨咒骂更加使他难受。

en.t: Genji felt that this attitude of hers pained him even more than jealousy or reproaches would have done.

units.source_text: 他心中怀疑：紫姬为什么对他如此漠不关心呢？

en.t: In his heart he wondered why Lady Murasaki seemed so indifferent to him.

units.source_text: 就怀着比往日更深的爱情，向她立誓永不变心。

en.t: With an affection deeper than ever before, he swore to her that his heart would never change.

units.source_text: 此次与胧月夜重叙之事，不可泄露。

en.t: This renewed meeting with Oborozukiyo could not be allowed to become known.

units.source_text: 但过去的勾当，紫姬全都知道，所以只得搪塞道：“昨夜与尚侍隔纸门谈话，似觉言犹未尽。

en.t: But Lady Murasaki knew all about his past dealings, so he could only make an excuse, saying, Last night I spoke with the Naishi no Kami through a paper door, and it seemed our conversation was still unfinished.

units.source_text: 日后拟再去访晤一次，必须秘密，不致引起物议才好。”

en.t: I mean to visit her once more later, but it must be kept secret so as not to stir up gossip.

units.source_text: 紫姬笑道：“你倒像是返老还童，比从前更加风流了！

en.t: Lady Murasaki smiled and said, You seem to have grown young again, and have become even more amorous than before.

units.source_text: 教我无依无靠，好痛苦啊！”

en.t: You leave me with no one to rely on, and it is so painful.

units.source_text: 终于不免流下泪来。

en.t: At last she could not help shedding tears.

units.source_text: 那双盈盈娇眼异常可怜。

en.t: Her lovely eyes, brimming with tears, looked heartbreakingly pitiful.

units.source_text: 源氏答道：“你这样心绪不安，我也很痛苦呢。

en.t: Genji answered, When you are so troubled in spirit, I suffer too.

units.source_text: 我若有错，你只管尽情地拧我也好，打我也好。

en.t: If I have done wrong, you may pinch me or strike me as much as you like.

units.source_text: 我从来不曾教导你说：做人不可坦率。

en.t: I have never taught you that a person should not be frank.

units.source_text: 你的脾气太固执了。”

en.t: Your nature is far too stubborn.

units.source_text: 他就劝慰她，说了千言万语，其间关于昨夜之事，终于也毫不隐瞒地说出了。

en.t: He comforted her and said countless things, and in the course of it he finally told her everything about the previous night without concealing anything.

units.source_text: 源氏不能立刻到三公主那里去，只管在这里安慰紫姬。

en.t: Genji could not go at once to the Third Princess, and simply stayed there comforting Lady Murasaki.

units.source_text: 三公主本人毫不介意，乳母等却啧有烦言。

en.t: The Third Princess herself did not mind in the least, but her nurses grumbled about it.

units.source_text: 如果三公主也嫉妒怨恨起来，源氏势必又多一种苦恼。

en.t: If the Third Princess too were to grow jealous and resentful, Genji would inevitably have yet another trouble to bear.

units.source_text: 现在太平无事，源氏便把她看作一个美丽可爱的玩偶。

en.t: Since all was peaceful for the moment, Genji regarded her as a beautiful and charming doll.
